facts.text: John met LeBron a few times and found the experience to be wild.

evidence.quote: I've had the chance to meet him a few times. He's real chill and it was a wild experience.

facts.text: John saw LeBron play live and found it to be a motivating experience.

evidence.quote: I also had the opportunity to see him play live. It was tough, but I learned a lot from watching a top player like him.

facts.text: John described the energy at the basketball game as incredible and mentioned it made him love his job.

evidence.quote: The energy was incredible! It's moments like these that make me love my job.
